claims.content: The Customer must be viewing the Home Page.
The system must have a populated inventory database containing product details such as Gemstone, Metal Purity, and Retail Category.
The Customer clicks on the 'Catalog Pages' link from the Home Page.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer clicks on the 'Catalog Pages' link from the Home Page.

claims.content: The Customer selects specific filters (e.g., Retail Category, Gemstone, Metal Purity) from the available dropdown lists to narrow the search results.
The system updates the 'Search Results' list to display only items matching the selected filter criteria.
If the Customer selects a product with an image in the results list, the system displays the thumbnail or allows viewing of the full image details.
The Customer clicks on a specific product row in the results grid to view detailed information such as 'Product ID', 'Description', 'Starts', 'Ends', and 'Duration'.
